description: What your rivals changed, newest first: technology and providers, shipping, ads, marketing messages, AI citations, agent readiness, hiring, performance, bestsellers, Terms / privacy / return / shipping policy and other info page changes (type 'Content Pages', with the number of changes per page), sales the brand extended (type 'Sale extended': the sentence with old and new end date and the receipt link of the ad, page or email), selling claims added or dropped and ad-vs-landing-page gaps (type 'Selling claims'), review rating moves (type 'Review rating': Google Maps kept apart from what a site shows about itself), and more (RivalSweeper's Domain Moves feed).
